label: Bible Study
prompt: For if our heart condemn us, God is _____ than our heart, and knoweth all things.
verse: For if our heart condemn us, God is greater than our heart, and knoweth all things.
note: When your own heart condemns you, God is greater — and he knows everything.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: And he said unto me, It is done. I am Alpha and Omega, the beginning and the end. I will give unto him that is athirst of the fountain of the water of life _____.
verse: And he said unto me, It is done. I am Alpha and Omega, the beginning and the end. I will give unto him that is athirst of the fountain of the water of life freely.
note: The water of life is offered freely — no price tag for the thirsty.

label: Sunday School
prompt: And was transfigured before them: and his face did shine as the sun, and his _____ was white as the light.
verse: And was transfigured before them: and his face did shine as the sun, and his raiment was white as the light.
note: On the mount of transfiguration Jesus' face shone like the sun, and even his raiment turned white as the light.

label: Deep Water
prompt: The ox knoweth his owner, and the ass his master's _____: but Israel doth not know, my people doth not consider.
verse: The ox knoweth his owner, and the ass his master's crib: but Israel doth not know, my people doth not consider.
note: Isaiah's opening rebuke: even an ox knows where to find its master's feeding trough; Israel doesn't.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: Whereupon, O king Agrippa, I was not _____ unto the heavenly vision:
verse: Whereupon, O king Agrippa, I was not disobedient unto the heavenly vision:
note: Paul before King Agrippa, summing up the Damascus road: 'I was not disobedient unto the heavenly vision.'
